name: Pwn2Own (ZDI/Trend Micro)
description: World's most elite hacking competition, awarding over $1 million per event. Since 2007, has grown to 3 events annually with 500+ zero-day vulnerabilities purchased.

peerReview.processDescription: Live exploitation against real software (browsers, OS, servers, automotive, IoT). ZDI experts independently verify each exploit. Vendor coordination for vulnerability verification. Point-based Master of Pwn tracking.

attribution.attributionNotes: Master of Pwn title. Cash prizes ($10K-$400K+ per exploit). ZDI advisories credit researchers publicly. Widely reported in industry media.

povsAlignment.description: Tool development / benchmarking through live exploitation competition with expert verification.
